messages.subject: This week: ICO guidance on processor due diligence, and AI Act timelines
messages.plaintextBody:
TechLaw Briefing – Weekly

In this issue: the ICO publishes refreshed guidance on controller/processor due diligence; EU AI Act implementation dates confirmed; three SaaS termination disputes worth watching; and a note on RPI-linked price escalation clauses post-2025.

You are receiving this because you subscribed. Unsubscribe at any time.
